items.title: Nvidia CEO's Affair Engulfs AI Giant in Spying Probe
items.summary: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, prompting the Nvidia board to launch an investigation. Bloomberg's Minmin Low breaks down the news and shares what Huang previously told Bloomberg about the company's succession plans.
